summary_md:
# Försvarsjättens nya drömsiffra

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-08-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Hosts Johan Wendel and Mikael Olsson of DI's Kort och Lång say the market mood is strongly positive. OMXS30 is up more than 30% over twelve months, lifted by AI hype and hopes that the US-Iran conflict will de-escalate. They cover Q2 reports from Yubico (up ~40% on the day), Rheinmetall (guidance cut, but an order book of over EUR 100bn targeted for end-2026), Paradox and Asmodee, the collapsed AstraZeneca-BMS merger rumour, and Wisag's opaque climb to a 29.99% stake in Coor. They also warn against paying premiums for investment companies such as Industrivärden.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RHM — Rheinmetall | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host optimistic; case intact despite guidance cut and F126 loss; order book guided >EUR 100bn by end-2026.

#### Reasoning

Host Johan Wendel says the report changed nothing and the case is intact. Germany is heading toward 3.5% of GDP on defence and Rheinmetall takes a large share of that spending. It also won a large Romania contract. The guidance cut was largely priced in (stock roughly flat). The company may position itself for the F127 frigate contract.

#### Sell Triggers

- German defence spending slows
- further contract losses like F126
- order book fails to reach EUR 100bn target

> *"jag är ju optimistiskt inställd till att alla aktien. Det var inget i den här rapporten som fick mig att ändra mig. utan jag tycker att caset är intakt."*

---

### 🟢 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host's April buy recommendation ('dividend machine') unchanged after in-line Q2; Gamescom reveals ahead.

#### Reasoning

Host (Mikael) says Q2 does not change his buy case. Sales grew ~14% with a 35% EBIT margin and operating profit up ~40%, and the company has a stable player base of 6m. Near-term drag: a slower Q3 release pace. He would like a capital markets day to sell the case better. Upcoming Gamescom project reveals could act as a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak Gamescom reveals / pipeline disappointment
- margin erosion
- player base declines

> *"Jag skrev en köprekommendation i april som veckans aktie som det heter att det här är liksom en utdelningsmaskin och att de ändå tuffar på bra och jag tycker inte det finns någonting egentligen som ändrar det caset med den här rapporten."*

---

### 🟢 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Very strong Q2 with >20% organic growth; stock up 30%+ since April 'veckans aktie'; buyout optionality.

#### Reasoning

Host praises the consistently high organic growth (~24% average). Caveats: growth is driven by lower-margin partner brands, and steady retail selling by Embracer-legacy owners is a constant drag on the stock. Upside optionality: Savvy plus private equity could buy the company out.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth slows
- own-brand growth fails to pick up
- continued retail owner outflow pressures price

> *"Så det går ju kanon för dem och det är ju bara att lyfta på hatten."*

---

### ⛔ INDU-C — Industrivärden | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Trades at ~5% premium to NAV with only listed holdings; hosts say better to buy underlying shares.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts call paying a premium for a holding company with only listed assets illogical. They see the premium as driven by monthly-saving flows, e.g. Spiltan. They warn it could still widen to 10%, so shorting needs timing. Their advice is to buy the underlying shares instead.

#### Sell Triggers

- premium turns into discount (becomes attractive)

> *"Men här och nu känns det ju svårt att motivera att köpa det här istället för att köpa underliggande aktier."*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

+40% on report from low levels; ~P/E 20 on 2028 requires optimism; market struggles to price it.

#### Reasoning

Host is neutral. Cybersecurity demand is growing, but it is unclear whether Yubico is the winner. P/E of about 20 on 2028 estimates needs optimistic assumptions. Competition risk and a long-term quantum-computing bear case count against it.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth stalls again
- competitors overtake technology
- quantum computing undermines encryption keys

> *"marknaden har lite svårt att prissätta det här åt båda hållen skulle jag säga"*

---

### 🟠 COOR — Coor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Wisag at 29.99% via opaque route; FI reviewing; possible buyout speculation.

#### Reasoning

Wisag, an industry giant, is sitting just below the 30% mandatory bid threshold. The host notes it might try to buy out the company. The Finansinspektionen (FI) review of possible flagging-rule breaches is the key event to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- FI finds no issue and Wisag stays passive
- Wisag sells down

> *"Eller de kanske kommer försöka köpa ut bolaget till och med."*

---
